description: Frozen pre-agreed training gate for the Phase 4 baseline (TRAIN-01, TRAIN-03). Pinned as committed data BEFORE any training step or measurement: this pin commit provably precedes every results artifact in git history (D-01 — the Phase 3 D-04 pre-agreement pattern, config/obs_gate.json cc1945b precedent). The runners (04-03 train.py, 04-04 evaluate_baseline.py + run_policy_audit.py, 04-05 judgment) READ this file by field name and never re-hardcode any pinned number (WR-02 discipline extended). Immutable once the first training step begins; a post-measurement edit invalidates every number this phase produces.

_doc.provenance: Every number below is pre-agreed decision data (04-CONTEXT.md D-01..D-06) or verified arithmetic over pinned constants — never a post-hoc choice. The consistency contract is tests/test_train_gate.py: any future gate change must re-derive from a decision, not convenience (T-04-04 tampering, T-04-05 repudiation, T-04-06 audit-bound mitigations).
_doc.D-01: The TRAIN-03 pass bar is pre-agreed BEFORE training: success_threshold_fraction=0.70 of spawns_total=25 frozen spawns -> min_spawns_successful=18, episodes_per_spawn=3 (episodes_total=75, anticipating Phase 5 EVAL-01), per_spawn_majority=2 (a spawn counts successful on a majority of its 3 episodes). 18/25 = 0.72 >= 0.70.
_doc.D-02: eval_modes=[deterministic, stochastic]; primary_bar=deterministic removes sampling noise so Phase 5 before/after comparisons measure perturbation effects, not eval noise; the stochastic success rate is reported alongside as a reference number.
_doc.D-03: retry.max_retries=1 at retry_budget_steps=2 x training_budget_steps = 3M steps (~3.3 h measured throughput, inside the 12 h window), then retry.on_second_miss=stop-and-investigate (reward, hyperparameters, env). A second miss is a debugging conversation, not a third run.
_doc.D-04: training_budget_steps=1500000 IS config/obs_gate.json phase4_budget_steps (read, never restated); train_window_hours=12 IS obs_gate window_hours (the 04-01 arm_train_tripwire reads the same pin). Fixed budget, not train-until-threshold; D-03's retry is the only escalation path.
_doc.D-05: checkpoint_selection=final-step: the final step's checkpoint is the frozen baseline for Phases 5-7 — no best-on-eval selection. Periodic checkpoints, if any, are crash-recovery only.
_doc.D-06: tuning: 3 learning_rate variants (lr_grid=[1e-4, 3e-4, 1e-3]) at steps_per_variant=100000, selection by the highest last-100-episode mean RAW episodic return (Monitor's episode record is raw below VecNormalize — 04-RESEARCH Pattern 3), tie_band_rel=0.01 (1% relative tie) -> tie_fallback_lr=3e-4 (the middle grid entry), seed=0 (the smoke run's SEED comparability). The pinned constants bind and are read-only data: gamma from fixed_overrides.gamma_source, n_steps=128 / batch_size=64 / n_envs=8 (the smoke divisibility: 8 x 128 = 1024 % 64 == 0), device=cpu (never MPS).
_doc.task1_action_space_decision: 04-02 Task 1 blocking decision, resolved by the user 2026-10-05: action_space_mode=rescale_minus_one_one — each training env is wrapped in gymnasium RescaleAction(rescale_min, rescale_max) = (-1, 1) around the raw asymmetric ctrlrange Box. Rationale: the symmetric [-1,1] space matches SB3's official PPO guidance (the initial Gaussian is centered at 0 with std 1) on a contact-rich task; the wrapper translates [-1,1] to the raw ctrlrange, so the scripted-policy/audit code paths using raw ctrl are unaffected. The mapping is pinned end-to-end by tests/test_train_gate.py (research A4 mitigation: action [-1] -> ctrl low, [+1] -> ctrl high, 0 -> per-dim midpoint, home ctrl inside [-1,1]).
_doc.pitfall_1_spawn_mode: spawn_mode=continuous for TRAINING envs (04-RESEARCH Pitfall 1): the env constructor default is grid and a no-options grid reset spawns index 0 EVERY episode — training on grid-default silently trains on one fixed cube position and the 25-spawn threshold eval would fail catastrophically. Eval/audit envs use grid mode + set_options over the frozen 25-spawn grid.
_doc.audit_bounds_derivation: audit_no_success_return_max=2.5: a no-place episode's return is bounded above by the 2.0 dense ceiling (FULL_FLAGS_NO_PLACE_MAX_FRACTION=0.2 x TERMINAL_PLACE_BONUS=10.0) minus the 2.0 time-penalty ceiling (TIME_PENALTY=0.01 x 200 max control steps, the pinned episode horizon EPISODE_SIM_SECONDS/(PHYSICS_TIMESTEP x DEFAULT_FRAME_SKIP)) = 0.0, so 2.5 leaves margin. audit_success_return_min=6.0: a successful episode's return is bounded below by the 10.0 terminal bonus minus the 2.0 dense ceiling minus the 2.0 time penalty = 6.0 (equality pinned). The 04-04 audit runner judges with <= for the no-success max and >= for the success min: a record at exactly 2.5 (is_success False) or 6.0 (True) is compliant; 2.6 (False) or 5.9 (True) is a reward-hacking violation (T-04-06).
_doc.pinned_by: 04-02-PLAN.md Task 2 (Phase 4, Baseline Training); Task 1 action-space decision resolved by the user via the blocking checkpoint
_doc.unblock_04_06: 04-06 pre-agreement (D-03 debugging conversation, approved 2026-10-17): the grasp predicate is loosened (so100rob.constants GRASP_WINDOW_STEPS 5->2, GRASP_TRACK_TOL_M 0.03->0.05 — the only env change; the dense-reward and PPO constants above stay FROZEN). The TRAIN-03 bar stays HELD at 18/25 deterministic for a clean comparison across the predicate change; the 04-03 LR tune re-runs on the new predicate with the same rule/grid before the 1.5M run (one 3M retry per D-03 if it misses).
_doc.unblock_04_07: 04-07 pre-agreement (the D-03 second-miss decision, ranked option 1 in runs/investigation-04-loose-predicate.md section 5, made 2026-10-22): the grasp predicate gains a COMPLETION-CHECKED off-floor z-clause — so100rob.constants GRASP_CUBE_OFF_FLOOR_Z_M=0.017 (pinned at CUBE_REST_Z_RANGE[1], 'above rest height') so the grasp flag additionally requires the cube center STRICTLY above this height at window completion; a closed-jaw push (cube in the rest band throughout) can never set grasp. The completion-check shape is probe-grounded (2026-10-22, all 25 frozen spawns: grasp flips at lift step 0 on 24 spawns / step 1 on spawn 23, lift at step 1/2 — strict approach < grasp < lift < place ordering holds everywhere and the flip always lands inside the lift run; the during-hold variant was falsified by the same probe). GRASP_WINDOW_STEPS=2 and GRASP_TRACK_TOL_M=0.05 keep their 04-06 values; every dense-reward constant (STAGE_POTENTIALS, APPROACH_W, APPROACH_POTENTIAL_SCALE_M, TERMINAL_PLACE_BONUS, TIME_PENALTY, REWARD_GAMMA) and PPO constant (lr_grid, n_steps=128, batch_size=64, n_envs=8, device=cpu, action_space_mode=rescale_minus_one_one) stays FROZEN — the off-floor z-clause is the ONLY change. The TRAIN-03 bar stays HELD at 18/25 deterministic (min_spawns_successful=18, never recalibrated); the audit bounds 2.5/6.0 stay unchanged. The 04-03 LR tune re-runs on the new predicate (same rule/grid/seed) before the 1.5M run, which consumes the tune's choice automatically; exactly ONE pinned 3M retry per D-03 if the first run misses (a flat 0/25 goes straight to stop-and-investigate — outcome (c) with no retry spent); on a second miss, no third run of any budget — stop-and-investigate.
_doc.unblock_04_08: 04-08 pre-agreement (the user's third D-03 decision, made 2026-10-23, ranked option 2 in runs/investigation-04-zclause.md section 5: the classical-CV feature track — the held Phase 3 revisit unheld BY that decision, mechanism per runs/investigation-04-cve-groundwork.md). FEATURE MECHANISM: SO100PickPlaceEnv(cv_features=True) (requires obs_mode='vision') appends a 4-dim MEASURED color-blob centroid tail [cube_centroid_uv, goal_centroid_uv] to the state key, growing it 28 -> 32 in CV mode (OBS_STATE_CV_DIM; the legacy 28-dim default contract is UNTOUCHED — every Phase 1/2 runner and the smoke runner stay byte-identical); the tail is a pure-numpy function of the rendered RGB frame ONLY (never simulator state — T-04-23), computed from the SAME single render the image key uses (one render per step); the mask bounds are PROBE-MEASURED, pinned from runs/cv_probe/<ts>/probe.json (04-08 probe run 20261023T230939Z: cube counts 8..13 px/spawn, affine fit max residual 0.276 px, goal 3 px/frame, goal centroid std 0.0 px). THROUGHPUT RULE: the mixed-obs chain's measured steps/s from the 16384-step tracer run must be >= config/obs_gate.json required_throughput_steps_per_sec (READ BY FIELD NAME, arithmetic re-checked: ceil(1500000 / (12 x 3600)) == 35 — the Phase 3 D-04 floor re-applied to the CV chain BEFORE any training compute); a miss stops the obs change with no training — the pre-agreement's obs-space rejection path. FROZEN: every dense-reward constant (STAGE_POTENTIALS, APPROACH_W, APPROACH_POTENTIAL_SCALE_M, TERMINAL_PLACE_BONUS, TIME_PENALTY, REWARD_GAMMA), the 04-07 grasp predicate (GRASP_CUBE_OFF_FLOOR_Z_M=0.017, GRASP_WINDOW_STEPS=2, GRASP_TRACK_TOL_M=0.05), every PPO constant (lr_grid, n_steps=128, batch_size=64, n_envs=8, device=cpu, action_space_mode=rescale_minus_one_one), the HELD TRAIN-03 bar (min_spawns_successful=18 deterministic, never recalibrated), and the 2.5/6.0 audit bounds — the CV track is an OBSERVATION change only. RE-TUNE: the 04-03 rule re-runs on the new obs contract (same rule/grid/seed) BEFORE the 1.5M run, which consumes the tune's choice automatically. D-03 (unchanged): exactly ONE pinned 3M retry if the first run misses (a flat 0/25 first run goes straight to outcome (c) with no retry spent); on a second miss, no third run of any budget — stop-and-investigate. Both judged chains (train.resolve_env_kwargs AND _eval_chain.build_eval_venv) construct cv_features=True — one contract, tamper-guarded by tests; a legacy 28-dim bundle load on the CV chain fails loudly at VecNormalize.load.

tuning.selection_rule: highest last-100-episode mean raw episodic return; variants within a 1% relative tie band (tie_band_rel) fall back to the middle grid lr 3e-4 (tie_fallback_lr)
